data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu contributed to UTMIST/Misty, Jeff15321/mathify-brief, UTMIST/UTMIST, qiuethan/neetcode-submissions, and SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer. He opened pull requests in Jeff15321/mathify-brief (#6, #7, #8), SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer (#1, #2), UTMIST/Misty (#377–#380), and UTMIST/UTMIST (#505, #507–#510), and reviewed UTMIST/Misty #347, #376, and #385. He also opened issues in UTMIST/Misty (#383, #384) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#504, #506).
